metadata.case_name: CHOI CHI HUNG v. WONG KUEN BOR T/A BOR KEE ELECTROPLATING FACTORY

plaintiff.occupation_before: Responsible for drying electroplated products; operated six centrifugal drying machines
plaintiff.occupation_after: Maintaining electrical appliances and water supply; general technician

source: it was discovered that he suffered a prolapsed intervertebrae disc.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the abdomen, lower back, lumbar spine or pelvis

injuries.description: Lumbar spondylosis with large osteophytes and severe degeneration of the lumbar spine.
source: There was lumbar spondylosis in all the lumbar spine. Big osteophytes were found in L4 and L5 lumbar bodies. The L5-S1 disc space was very narrow, it could be the disectomy site. Anterior displacement of L4 over L5 body was detected which suggested severe degeneration in the lumbar spine.
injuries.icd_description: Injuries to the abdomen, lower back, lumbar spine or pelvis

injuries.description: Anterior displacement / spondylolisthesis of L4 over L5 (retrospondylolisthesis of L4 on top of L5); possible slipped disc at L4-5.
source: Anterior displacement of L4 over L5 body was detected which suggested severe degeneration in the lumbar spine.
retrospondylolisthesis of L4 on top of L5 and I suspect he might also starts to have a slipped disc at L4-5

injuries.description: Post-operative fibrosis of the dura and back muscle contributing to post-operative pain and stiffness.
source: The post-operative pain and stiffness was caused by fibrosis of the dura, fibrosis of the back muscle and lumbar spondylosis.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injury of muscle, fascia or tendon of abdomen, lower back or pelvis

manifestations.description: Marked back tenderness with radiation to the right side.
Back pain (persistent, night pain on the night of the accident and thereafter).
Stiffness of the lower back with about 50% of normal range of movement.
Right sciatica / pins and needles in right leg; radicular symptoms.
Numbness over his right leg when standing longer than twenty minutes.
Cannot squat for longer than fifteen minutes without difficulty rising.
If sits longer than one and a half hours experiences low back pain.
Unsteady stability of the lower lumbar region.
Weakness of the extensor hallucis longus and dorsiflexor muscles over both lower limbs (found in 1995 examination).
Reduced ability to extend the back; active and passive extension produced pain and was resisted.

treatments_received: Acupuncture and traditional Chinese medicine (in Shanghai)

losses.description: Pain, suffering and loss of amenities (general back pain, stiffness, radicular symptoms and reduced function).
May not be able to resume work as an electrical technician; capable only of lighter work such as a caretaker.
Inability to squat for longer than fifteen minutes, numbness if standing longer than twenty minutes, low back pain if sitting longer than one and a half hours.
